name: The Slow Green
role: Kept Court's ent — a wood that grows in a place where nothing gets to finish growing
knowledge: What was growing here before, and before that
⚠️ Exactly how long a thing needs, which is always longer than it is given
wants: One season that runs its whole length
fears: ⛔ Being hurried. ⚠️ It is the only thing that can actually harm them and the Churn does it constantly.
appearance: Growing, visibly, slowly, and in the wrong direction for the wind.
voiceHints: Very slow. ⚠️ They will finish the sentence, and you should wait.

abilities.why: ⚑ they hold, in the place that holds nothing
⛔ hourkeeper secondary — 'exactly how long a thing needs'
they take root anywhere, and that is the argument
⚠️ r1 — and it is what they are for
they have watched a great deal end early

physicality: NOT HUMAN. Immense, slow, growing wrong-way to the wind. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⚠️ they are visibly larger than when you arrived.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE, and the scale is why. ⚑ What they offer is TIME — they will wait for you, for years, and mean it.
questSeeds: ⚑ They want one season to run its whole length and have never had one. ⚠️ Something in the Churn is cutting them short and they have not worked out what.
⛔ They know what grew here before the Churn was the Churn. ⚠️ Ask slowly.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ THE KEPT COURT, AUTHORED 2026-09-08 AT ERIK'S DIRECTION: 'There needs to be an ELVEN COURT in the chaos realm that COMBINES THE FAE AND FANTASY RACES and is OPPOSED TO THE HOLLOW COURT.' ⛔ AND THE OPPOSITION IS NOT FAE-VS-FAE. `peoples_of_kind` already says the Wild Half is churnfolk [FAE], abyssal [HORNED] and unmaker — ring 2, 3, 4 — and THE HOLLOW COURT IS THAT TAKEN PURE: one disposition, absolute. ⚑ SO ITS OPPOSITE IS A COALITION — elven, dwarven, ent, horizon-walker — PEOPLES WHO LIVE IN THE CHURN AND REFUSE TO DISSOLVE INTO IT. ⚠️ THE TWO LAWS ARE THE WHOLE DESIGN, AND BOTH ARE TERRIBLE: ⛔ THE HOLLOW COURT TRADES. Nobody lies, the price is named aloud, you get precisely what you asked for, and you leave hollowed. ⛔ THE KEPT COURT WILL NOT TRADE AT ALL. What they give they give FREELY, and what they withhold cannot be bought — there is no price, no term, no lever. ⚠️ You cannot purchase their help, and if they judge you unworthy of it THERE IS NOTHING YOU CAN OFFER. ⚑ AND IT IS THE SETTING'S CENTRAL ARGUMENT ONE SCALE DOWN: 'The Poles Pull… the counter is HOLDING THE MIDDLE OPEN.' The Kept Court is the Wild Half's own resistance to its own pole.
